def mvcc.wsCloserM (s st : Loc) (γs : mvcc.StoreNames) (c : Int) : IProp GF :=
  if mvcc.kbCmpM γs.kb then mvcc.wsCloserR s st γs c else mvcc.wsCloser s st γs

theorem mvcc.wsCloserM_on (s st : Loc) (γs : mvcc.StoreNames) (c : Int) (h : mvcc.kbCmpM γs.kb) :
    mvcc.wsCloserM s st γs c ⊣⊢ mvcc.wsCloserR s st γs c

theorem mvcc.wsCloserR_of_wsCloser (s st : Loc) (γs : mvcc.StoreNames) (h : γs.cm = true) (E :
    CoPset) : ⊢ mvcc.wsCloser s st γs -∗ mvcc.crevRightM γs ={E}=∗ mvcc.wsCloserR s st γs (-1)

theorem mvcc.wsCloserR_iff (s st : Loc) (γs : mvcc.StoreNames) (c : Int) : mvcc.wsCloserR s st γs c
    ⊣⊢ ∃ stc, typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watchableStore
    go!"stopc" s) stc DFrac.discard ∗ mvcc.stopCloser stc ∗ mvcc.wsWaiter s ∗ mvcc.compactRightR st
    γs c

theorem mvcc.wsCloserM_off (s st : Loc) (γs : mvcc.StoreNames) (c : Int) (h : ¬mvcc.kbCmpM γs.kb) :
    mvcc.wsCloserM s st γs c ⊣⊢ mvcc.wsCloser s st γs

theorem mvcc.wsCloserM_close (s st : Loc) (γs : mvcc.StoreNames) (c : Int) : mvcc.wsCloserM s st γs
    c ⊢ ∃ stc, typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watchableStore
    go!"stopc" s) stc DFrac.discard ∗ mvcc.stopCloser stc ∗ mvcc.wsWaiter s ∗ mvcc.storeCloserM st
    γs c

def (sealed) mvcc.wsCloserR (s st : Loc) (γs : mvcc.StoreNames) (c : Int) : IProp GF
